description: Source code for the crash generation server component of Google Breakpad, handling crash report collection, minidump creation, and inter-process communication.

classes.name: CrashGenerationServer
classes.description: Handles crash report collection, minidump creation, and communication with crashed processes.

methods.name: CrashGenerationServer::Start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the crash generation server thread.

methods.name: CrashGenerationServer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the server thread and cleans up resources.

methods.name: CrashGenerationServer::CreateReportChannel
methods.description: Creates a socketpair for crash report communication.

methods.name: CrashGenerationServer::Run
methods.description: Main server loop handling incoming crash reports and control commands.

methods.name: CrashGenerationServer::ClientEvent
methods.description: Processes crash report messages from crashed clients.

methods.name: CrashGenerationServer::ControlEvent
methods.description: Handles control commands such as shutdown.

methods.name: CrashGenerationServer::MakeMinidumpFilename
methods.description: Generates a unique filename for minidump files.

methods.name: CrashGenerationServer::ThreadMain
methods.description: Thread entry point executing the server loop.
